# GitRunByKaru (grbk) v2.2.0

> CLI tool & runtime engine for running conventional GitHub repositories locally.
> npm: `gitrunbykaru` | alias: `grbk` | MCP: `@gitrunbykaru/mcp-server`

## What It Does
- Clones public GitHub repos (shallow, --depth 1) to OS temp dir
- Detects framework (Node/Next/Vite, Python/Flask/Django/FastAPI, Go, Rust, Static)
- Auto-mocks `.env` from `.env.example` with placeholder keys
- Installs deps (npm/yarn/pnpm/bun, pip/pipenv)
- Launches dev server, verifies HTTP readiness, opens browser
- Cleans up temp dir + process tree on exit (Ctrl+C)

## What It Does NOT Do
- Private repos (no auth support)
- Databases (Postgres, Redis, etc.) - must run locally
- Monorepos with multiple concurrent services
- Build/deploy (dev server only)
- Production deployments
- Windows GUI apps

## Install
`npm install -g gitrunbykaru`

## Usage
`grbk https://github.com/user/repo` or `grbk .` for local workspace

## Flags
- `--no-open` — Skip opening browser
- `--keep` — Keep temp directory after exit
- `--json` — Machine-readable RuntimeSession JSON
- `--port <n>` — Preferred port (tool still detects from output)
- `--mcp` — Show MCP setup guide

## MCP Server (AI Agents)
Package: `@gitrunbykaru/mcp-server` (on npm)
Config:
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "gitrunbykaru": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@gitrunbykaru/mcp-server"] } } }
```
Tools: `gitrun_remote({ repoUrl, preferredPort? })`, `gitrun_local({ workspacePath, preferredPort? })`, `gitrun_stop({ sessionId })`

## Supported Frameworks (Stable)
- **Node.js:** Next.js, Vite, React, Express, Fastify, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Astro, Remix
- **Python:** Flask, Django, FastAPI (virtualenv isolated)
- **Static HTML**

## Supported Frameworks (Experimental)
- **Go:** Gin, Fiber, Echo, Chi, standard net/http
- **Rust:** Axum, Actix-web, Rocket, Cargo
